model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes for six different language model architectures—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine distinct language families or groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these language groups in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” ranges from 0 to 30 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language group is represented by a cluster of six bars, each corresponding to one model variant and colored distinctly according to the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating variability or uncertainty in the measured effect. The bar heights visually represent the mean effect size for each model within each language group. For example, in the IE-Indic group, the tallest bar is for mBERT-B₂ (dark red), reaching approximately 23, while the shortest bar in the same group is for mBERT-L₂ (light blue), which is near zero. In the Semitic group, the tallest bar is for XLM-B₂ (dark red), reaching approximately 20, and the shortest bar is for mBERT-R₂ (light green), which is near zero. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the language groups along the x-axis. No bars are visually emphasized with special formatting such as shading or bold outlines beyond the standard color coding and error bars.
